cards.title: Managing Kids' Meltdowns From Toddlers to Teens
cards.body: Tantrums and mood swings are normal developmental markers, but they can be challenging for parents to navigate. Experts share practical strategies for reducing conflict during these inevitable phases of childhood.

cards.title: Toddlers' Culture Deserves Respect and Understanding
cards.body: Small children have their own ways of engaging with the world that adults should honor rather than dismiss. Respecting toddler autonomy—from their singing to their collections—matters more than we realize.

cards.title: Don't Buy Grand Theft Auto VI for Your Child
cards.body: Rockstar's new game is rated 18 for explicit sex, drugs, and violence content. Parents should understand it's genuinely unsuitable for children despite its popularity.

cards.title: Understanding PDA in Children: Science vs. Social Media
cards.body: PDA (Pathological Demand Avoidance) is often confused with ODD, but they're distinct conditions. Parents should seek accurate information from credible sources rather than relying on social media interpretations.

cards.title: Teachers Need Better Knowledge of Left-Handedness
cards.body: Teachers play a crucial role in writing education but often lack understanding of left-handed children's specific needs. Better training could improve learning outcomes for this group.

cards.title: Managing When Your Adult Child Pulls Away
cards.body: Silence from adult children can be emotionally painful for parents. Here are practical strategies to cope with that empty feeling while respecting boundaries.

cards.title: Navigating Generational Differences During Holidays
cards.body: Different generations often clash over holiday expectations and traditions. Finding common ground requires understanding each perspective and creating space for new family rituals.

cards.title: Zines: A Powerful Learning Tool for All Ages
cards.body: Zines help children and students explore ideas creatively while making learning personal and memorable. They're simple to make yet rich with educational potential.

cards.title: Cold, Flu or Covid? How to Tell the Difference
cards.body: Understanding which illness your child has helps guide appropriate care and treatment. BBC Health explains the key differences between these common illnesses.

cards.title: NHS Warns of Flu Surge in Vulnerable Populations
cards.body: Hospital admissions for flu are rising significantly as winter sets in. Health officials urge at-risk groups, including children, to get vaccinated immediately.
